Create an append-only reactive log (D54/D60) in `graph`. DELTA + lazy SNAPSHOT + REQUEST via
{@link collectionCore}; this layer adds the typed append surface + incremental view/scan.

## Import

```ts
import { reactiveLog } from "@graphrefly/ts/data-structures";
```

## Signature

```ts
function reactiveLog(
	graph: Graph,
	initial?: readonly T[],
	options: ReactiveLogOptions = {},
): ReactiveLog<T>
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `graph` | `Graph` | The graph that builds the log's nodes. |
| `initial` | `readonly T[]` | Optional initial log contents. |
| `options` | `ReactiveLogOptions` | Optional name, ring-buffer cap, and view memo policy. |

## Returns

A `ReactiveLog<T>` value.

## Example

```ts
import { graph } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
import { reactiveLog } from "@graphrefly/ts/data-structures";

const log = reactiveLog<string>(graph(), [], { maxSize: 100 });
log.append("started");
```
